schema.name: project_id
schema.label: Project Id
schema.description: One row per project. The project this dredge chart config belongs to.

schema.name: bg_path
schema.label: Background Image Path
schema.description: Isopach/background image shown under the chart.

schema.name: colorbar_path
schema.label: Colorbar Path
schema.description: Legend/color-scale image overlaid on the chart.

schema.name: georef
schema.label: Georeference
schema.description: {wL, wR, wT, wB} real-world coordinates the background image is pinned to.

schema.name: default_area_id
schema.label: Default Area
schema.description: Identifies the default project area displayed on the dredge chart.

schema.name: default_material_note
schema.label: Default Material Note
schema.description: Supplies the default material-encountered description for new charts.

schema.name: chart_title_override
schema.label: Chart Title Override
schema.description: Optional chart title used instead of the project name.

schema.name: cells_path
schema.label: Cell Grid Path
schema.description: Path to the grid-cells definition file (Kalamazoo-style CSC projects).

schema.name: aerial_path
schema.label: Aerial Image Path
schema.description: Optional aerial photo, used as an alternate background layer.

schema.name: aerial_georef
schema.label: Aerial Georeference
schema.description: {wL, wR, wT, wB} real-world coordinates the aerial photo is pinned to.

schema.name: crs_definition
schema.label: CRS Definition
schema.description: Stores the project coordinate system as WKID, EPSG, or WKT.

schema.name: aerial_tiles
schema.label: Aerial Tiles
schema.description: Array of {path, georef} for tiled aerial imagery.

schema.name: data_source
schema.label: Data Source
schema.description: Which upload format this project uses: 'hypack' (hydraulic) or 'earthworks' (mechanical). Defaults to 'hypack'.

schema.name: water_elev_ft
schema.label: Water Elevation (ft)
schema.description: Stores the water elevation used to filter Earthworks observations.

schema.name: earthworks_design_path
schema.label: Earthworks Design Surface Path
schema.description: Stores the file path of the Earthworks design surface.

schema.name: require_stations
schema.label: Require Stations
schema.description: Whether this project requires station/chainage entry before generating the daily chart (river/channel-style projects). Defaults to false.

schema.name: reference_lines_path
schema.label: Mile Markers / Stationing DXF Path
schema.description: Mile markers / stationing DXF -- open line segments and text labels drawn as a thin reference overlay (e.g. tenth-mile lines with river-mile numbers). Purely visual; not used in any calculation. Referenced in the web app's code but not present on the live dredge_config table there (schema drift) -- added here for forward parity.

schema.name: alignment_path
schema.label: Hard-Structure Alignment DXF Path
schema.description: Hard-structure alignment DXF (sheet-pile wall / bulkhead), for earthworks/mechanical projects -- coverage that stops just short of it gets carried to it, within the wall-snap distance. Same schema-drift note as reference_lines_path.

schema.name: reference_surface_path
schema.label: Reference Survey Surface Path
schema.description: Latest QA pay survey (gridded 1x1 .xyz), used for hydraulic design-grade volume estimation. Same schema-drift note as reference_lines_path.

schema.name: split_gap_ft
schema.label: Split Gap (ft)
schema.description: Gap (ft) between coverage footprints above which the daily offers to split the chart into zoomed per-area pages. Null = app default (400).

schema.name: isopach_tiles
schema.label: Isopach Tiles
schema.description: Array of {path, georef:{wL,wR,wT,wB}} for tiled isopach/difference imagery, when one image cannot cover the whole project.

schema.name: cells_reference_only
schema.label: Cells Reference Only
schema.description: When true, the cells DXF is drawn as outlines + numbers only (a reference layer), with no coverage grid, clipping, or per-cell breakdown.

schema.name: bucket_width_ft
schema.label: Bucket Width (ft)
schema.description: PM-confirmed mechanical dredging bucket width (stamp diameter), used by the machine-track engine.

schema.name: track_bed_tolerance_ft
schema.label: Track Bed Tolerance (ft)
schema.description: How close the machine-track teeth must be to the local bed to count as an active digging point.

schema.name: alignment_snap_ft
schema.label: Alignment Snap (ft)
schema.description: Max gap (ft) the hard-structure alignment snap will close -- only gaps this narrow, and only where the bucket already worked.

schema.name: volume_mode
schema.label: Volume Mode
schema.description: How the daily CY is measured. Null = off (no volume). 'surface_diff' = prior-vs-today surface drop (mechanical). 'design_grade' = remaining prism above design_elev_ft over first-touch coverage (hypack).

schema.name: design_elev_ft
schema.label: Design Grade Elevation (ft)
schema.description: Design grade elevation in project datum ft, used by design_grade volume mode.

schema.name: reference_surface_date
schema.label: Reference Surface Date
schema.description: Date of the QA pay survey stored in reference_surface_path, shown to the PE so a stale reference is visible.

schema.name: reference_cell_ft
schema.label: Reference Cell Size (ft)
schema.description: Cell size (ft) the reference survey was downsampled to. Null = app default (2 ft).

schema.name: volume_recovery_factor
schema.label: Volume Recovery Factor
schema.description: Factor applied to gross calculated/measured volume to get the reportable volume (the bucket/cut always exceeds what reaches the barge).

schema.name: bg_original_name
schema.label: Background Image Original Filename
schema.description: Original filename of the uploaded isopach/background image, as picked by the user (the bg_path field stores the crd_files_b file id, not a human-readable name).

schema.name: bg_storage_path
schema.label: Background Image Storage Path
schema.description: Physical storage path/key of the uploaded isopach/background image file, as returned by the file-storage backend.

schema.name: colorbar_original_name
schema.label: Colorbar Original Filename
schema.description: Original filename of the uploaded colorbar/legend image, as picked by the user (the colorbar_path field stores the crd_files_b file id, not a human-readable name).

schema.name: colorbar_storage_path
schema.label: Colorbar Storage Path
schema.description: Physical storage path/key of the uploaded colorbar/legend image file, as returned by the file-storage backend.

schema.name: cells_original_name
schema.label: Cell Grid Original Filename
schema.description: Original filename of the uploaded cell-grid definition DXF, as picked by the user (the cells_path field stores the crd_files_b file id, not a human-readable name).

schema.name: cells_storage_path
schema.label: Cell Grid Storage Path
schema.description: Physical storage path/key of the uploaded cell-grid definition DXF file, as returned by the file-storage backend.

schema.name: aerial_original_name
schema.label: Aerial Image Original Filename
schema.description: Original filename of the uploaded aerial base-layer image, as picked by the user (the aerial_path field stores the crd_files_b file id, not a human-readable name).

schema.name: aerial_storage_path
schema.label: Aerial Image Storage Path
schema.description: Physical storage path/key of the uploaded aerial base-layer image file, as returned by the file-storage backend.

schema.name: earthworks_design_original_name
schema.label: Earthworks Design Surface Original Filename
schema.description: Original filename of the uploaded Earthworks design-grade surface CSV, as picked by the user (the earthworks_design_path field stores the crd_files_b file id, not a human-readable name).

schema.name: earthworks_design_storage_path
schema.label: Earthworks Design Surface Storage Path
schema.description: Physical storage path/key of the uploaded Earthworks design-grade surface CSV file, as returned by the file-storage backend.

schema.name: reference_lines_original_name
schema.label: Mile Markers / Stationing Original Filename
schema.description: Original filename of the uploaded mile-marker/stationing DXF, as picked by the user (the reference_lines_path field stores the crd_files_b file id, not a human-readable name).

schema.name: reference_lines_storage_path
schema.label: Mile Markers / Stationing Storage Path
schema.description: Physical storage path/key of the uploaded mile-marker/stationing DXF file, as returned by the file-storage backend.

schema.name: alignment_original_name
schema.label: Hard-Structure Alignment Original Filename
schema.description: Original filename of the uploaded hard-structure alignment DXF, as picked by the user (the alignment_path field stores the crd_files_b file id, not a human-readable name).

schema.name: alignment_storage_path
schema.label: Hard-Structure Alignment Storage Path
schema.description: Physical storage path/key of the uploaded hard-structure alignment DXF file, as returned by the file-storage backend.

schema.name: reference_surface_original_name
schema.label: Reference Survey Surface Original Filename
schema.description: Original filename of the uploaded QA pay survey .xyz file, as picked by the user (the reference_surface_path field stores the crd_files_b file id, not a human-readable name).

schema.name: reference_surface_storage_path
schema.label: Reference Survey Surface Storage Path
schema.description: Physical storage path/key of the uploaded QA pay survey .xyz file file, as returned by the file-storage backend.
